research.community: Private island off Abu Dhabi Corniche
overview: The 90 private homes have six to eight en-suite bedrooms, a basement and rooftop terrace. The largest estates add a guesthouse and wellness pavilion.
Separately, the resort includes 60 rooms and suites and 30 villas. Confirm resident access and membership terms.
research.locationNote: Eagle Hills describes a horseshoe-shaped island extending Abu Dhabi’s Corniche, accessible by bridge or sea. Its exact parcel remains unverified; the portal’s Saadiyat address was excluded.
research.priceNote: No dated developer price list or selected-home quotation was verified.
research.paymentNote: No original payment schedule or independently corroborated instalment terms were verified.
research.handoverNote: The current Bvlgari operator page targets a 2031 resort opening; Eagle Hills still gives 2030, also stated in its 19 June 2025 announcement. Neither establishes the selected mansion’s contractual handover.
